systems.platform: tablet application feeding an online platform, developed with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: pilot by the Provincial Government of Huíla: 1,843 schools in its 14 municipalities, surveyed by 28 technicians, two from each municipality

note: A UNICEF article of 2017 on a tablet survey of schools in Huíla for the education ministry's SIGE; the technicians transmit from the field when a signal is found, and no municipal administration office is said to be connected.
